title: Several first-party cookies are set httpOnly and lax but without the secure flag (post-login target, referral, marketplace entry stamp, funnel cohort).

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: app/sign-in/actions.ts:92-97 (POST_LOGIN_COOKIE, also :147), proxy.ts:248-253 (MARKETPLACE_ENTRY_COOKIE), proxy.ts:284-289 (REF_COOKIE), app/c/[token]/route.ts:76, app/join/(induction)/feature-actions.ts:77. Other cookies in the repo (lead-actions.ts:171, hosted/*/enter routes) do set secure. HSTS preload is on (next.config.ts:163) so exposure is small.

WHY IT MATTERS: Inconsistent hardening; a downgrade or mixed-content request could leak the stashed next path or referral id. No account takeover path found.

FIX DIRECTION: Add secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' to each, ideally through one shared cookie-options helper.

2026-11-16 fixed (security thread): new lib/http/cookie-secure.ts (SECURE_COOKIE, on in production) applied to the post-login target, sign-in notice, referral, marketplace entry, QR ref/variant/lead-grab, view-as, context, network-notice and funnel cohort cookies.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
